sv.title: ”Inte ett enda våldsutsatt barn ska missas”
sv.summary: Vården måste bli bättre på att fånga upp våldsutsatta barn och unga, anser Socialstyrelsen.

en.title: "Not a single child exposed to violence should be missed"
en.summary: Health care must get better at identifying children and young people exposed to violence, the National Board of Health and Welfare argues.
